xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:camunda="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/bpmn" id="Definitions_collab" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn" xmlns:zeebe="http://camunda.org/schema/zeebe/1.0">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_request" name="Request"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_1">
    <bpmn:extensionElements>
      <zeebe:properties>
        <zeebe:property name="owner" value="fulfilment"/>
      </zeebe:properties>
    </bpmn:extensionElements>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_buyer" name="Buyer" processRef="Process_buyer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_seller" name="Seller" processRef="Process_seller"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_carrier" name="Carrier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_order" sourceRef="Participant_buyer" targetRef="Participant_seller" name="Order" messageRef="Message_request"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ack" sourceRef="Participant_seller" targetRef="Participant_buyer" name="Acknowledgement"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_buyer" name="Buyer" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_buyer">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ordering" name="Ordering">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_buyer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_place_order</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_receiving" name="Receiving">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_buyer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_buyer" name="Need identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_b1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_place_order" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="place-order" name="Place order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_b1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_b2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_buyer" name="Ordered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_b2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_b1" sourceRef="Start_buyer" targetRef="Task_place_order"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_b2" sourceRef="Task_place_order" targetRef="End_buyer"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_seller" name="Seller" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_seller">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_s1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_seller">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_s1</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_s1" sourceRef="Start_seller" targetRef="End_seller"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
